description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Radiant Lotus tokens, untapping the nontoken Radiant Lotus.
Activate the nontoken Radiant Lotus by tapping it and sacrificing two Radiant Lotus tokens, adding {6}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
